title: Spec 02-physical-link.md duplicated section 4.5 contradicts itself (FNV vs CRC32 canonical)
description: While fixing the crc32_init drift (worker6-6qy5): spec/02-physical-link.md section 4.5 DAD Retry Strategy pins fnv1a32 pseudocode (derive_short_addr = fnv1a32(eui64) & 0xFFFF), and the section 3.4 summary line also says short-address DAD uses FNV-1a32. But the canonical decision (project-LICHEN-bo37, resolved) and both implementations - Python lichen.link.short_addr.derive_short_addr (crc32_ieee with init 0x4348454e = low32 of ASCII LICHEN) and Rust lichen-core short_addr.rs (LICHEN_CRC32_INITIAL = 0x4348_454e) - use CRC32-IEEE. The committed tests assert crc32 (python/tests/test_vectors.py test_dad_hash_algorithm_resolution, rust/lichen-core/tests/short_addr_vectors.rs authoritative_crc32_clarification_vectors). The module docstring calls the spec fnv section 'the duplicate 4.5 at the end'. Fix: deduplicate section 4.5 in spec/02-physical-link.md to the crc32_ieee pseudocode, fix the 3.4 summary line, and keep FNV-1a32 only for TDMA/channel-selection hash_32. Spec file - outside agent scope for the vector-fix session, hence this bead.
